data.exact_reserve_text: Change in estimates of prior year provisions (2,576)
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross release in prior year claims reserves of GBP 2.576m in 2024 (a reduction of approximately 10.7% of opening gross claims outstanding), disclosed as a "Change in estimates of prior year provisions" in the technical provisions note. The report does not quantify line-by-line reserve movements or attribute the release to specific named events; it is presented as favourable prior-year development.
raw_causal_phrases: Change in estimates of prior year provisions (2,576)
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' 2023 comparative column. Prior year development taken from Technical Provisions note row 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions (2,576)'. All source figures in the report are presented in GBP '000 and have been converted to millions. No narrative attributing the prior year movement to specific events or LOBs was provided; LOB-level reserve movements are not disclosed. Claims development triangle is present and could be used as cross-check but the explicit gross prior year movement was used as primary source.
